{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for confounding by age and baseline severity
# First, check distribution of age by gender
print('Age by gender:')
print(df.groupby('sex')['age'].describe())

# Check distribution of baseline severity by gender
print('\nBaseline severity by gender:')
print(df.groupby('sex')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True))

# Check if age and severity are associated with response
print('\nResponse by severity:')
print(df.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean())

print('\nResponse by age group (median split):')
age_median = df['age'].median()
print(df.groupby(pd.cut(df['age'], [0, age_median, 100]))['responded'].mean())"}
